form.billing_kind_one_time_hint: Customer charged once at engagement signup. No further invoices on this engagement.
form.billing_kind_recurring_hint: Billed every cycle. Engagement auto-renews until cancelled.
form.billing_kind_contract_hint: Fixed-term engagement with a defined end date. Can bill periodically within the term or as a single total at signup.
form.billing_kind_milestone_hint: Invoice fires per milestone (engagement phase) as deliverables complete. Requires an Engagement Template on the parent Package.
form.billing_kind_ad_hoc_hint: Operator-requested service calls. Choose Total Package for a prepaid retainer or Per service call for pay-per-call.
form.amount_basis_per_cycle_hint: Amount charged each billing cycle. Required for Recurring and Contract-with-cycle engagements.
form.amount_basis_total_package_hint: Single total amount charged across the full engagement term. One invoice covers everything; no per-cycle billing.
form.amount_basis_derived_from_lines_hint: Total computed automatically from the per-item rate-card rows. Amount input is hidden when this is selected.
form.amount_basis_per_occurrence_hint: Amount charged per delivered service call. On-call engagements only — each call fires its own invoice.
form.entitled_occurrences_info: Number of service calls included in the prepaid retainer. Required when amount basis is Total Package on an On-call engagement.
form.term_open_ended_help: Leave empty for open-ended / no expiration
form.schedule_locked_tooltip: This rate card is reserved for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_auto_create_hint: No rate card exists for {{.ClientName}} yet — one will be created automatically when you save.
form.schedule_auto_reuse_hint: This package will be added to the existing rate card for {{.ClientName}}.
form.schedule_client_picker_notice: Only packages assigned to this client are available below.
form.schedule_general_picker_notice: Packages assigned specifically to clients are not available for assignment to general-scoped rate cards.
form.parent_schedule_client_notice: This rate card belongs to {{.ClientName}}. Packages created here will be available only for engagements with this client.

product_price.empty_msg: No service prices have been configured for this rate card yet.

messages.pricing_locked_reason: This package is in use by active engagements. Pricing changes are disabled. You can still rename or reassign the package.
messages.item_pricing_locked_reason: This package is in use by active engagements. Item price and currency are locked to keep billing consistent.
messages.create_not_available: Service price plan create is not available.
messages.update_not_available: Service price plan update is not available.
messages.delete_not_available: Service price plan delete is not available.
messages.in_use_cannot_modify: This package is in use by active engagements. Item price and currency are locked.

per_cycle.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} every {{.CycleLabel}}. Engagement auto-renews until cancelled.
per_cycle.operations: Each cycle spawns {{.VisitsPerCycle}} engagement Job(s) (if Package has an Engagement Template). Work Plans tab shows cycle accordions.
per_cycle.revenue: One invoice per cycle. Generate Invoice creates the invoice and (via piggyback) spawns the engagement Job if missing.

derived_from_lines.operations: Each cycle spawns 1+ engagement Jobs. Operations tracking flows through the Package's Engagement Template.
derived_from_lines.revenue: Invoice total computed from rate card lines; one invoice per cycle.

total_package.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime engagement Job (or cycle Jobs if cyclic — see Package's visits_per_cycle).
total_package.revenue: One invoice at signup; cycle Jobs are operational only.

total_package.operations: Lifetime engagement Job with phases. BillingEvent rows gate per-milestone invoicing.
total_package.revenue: Invoice per milestone trigger; sum across milestones equals the total package.

total_package.operations: Engagement spawns 1 lifetime engagement Job with phases (if Package has an Engagement Template).
total_package.revenue: One invoice at engagement signup covering the full amount.

total_package.operations: Operator requests each service call from the Work Plans tab. Retainer exhausts after {{.EntitledOccurrences}} calls — operator can extend.
total_package.revenue: One invoice at engagement signup covering the entire retainer; subsequent service calls are operationally tracked only.

per_occurrence.customer: Charged {{.Amount}} per service call. No upfront cost.
per_occurrence.operations: Operator requests each service call from the Work Plans tab. Each completed call flips its BillingEvent to READY for invoicing.
per_occurrence.revenue: One invoice per delivered service call. Generate Invoice per call row.

warning.milestone_no_template: Milestone billing requires the Package to have an Engagement Template. Configure it on the Package first.
warning.recurring_no_template: This engagement will not have operational tracking. Add an Engagement Template to the Package to enable cycle Jobs.
warning.visits_per_cycle_invalid_kind: visits_per_cycle is only valid for cyclic packages. Reset to 1 or change the billing kind.
warning.ad_hoc_pool_no_template: On-call retainer engagements require an Engagement Template so service calls can be tracked.
warning.ad_hoc_per_call_no_template: Per-call engagements require an Engagement Template so service calls can be tracked.
warning.ad_hoc_no_entitlement: On-call retainer engagements need entitled service calls > 0. Set the value or switch to per-call billing.
warning.ad_hoc_billing_cycle_not_allowed: On-call engagements are event-driven, not calendar-driven. Remove the billing cycle.
warning.ad_hoc_visits_per_cycle_not_allowed: On-call engagements cannot use multi-visit cycles. Reset visits_per_cycle to 1.

subscriptions.empty_message: Engagements billing this package will appear here.
subscriptions.confirm_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete engagement %s? This action cannot be undone.

confirms.edit_amount_multiple_subscriptions: This rate card is attached to {{.Count}} active engagements for {{.ClientName}}. Changing the amount or cycle will affect all of them on the next bill cycle. Continue?

errors.in_use: This plan is in use by active engagements and cannot be deleted.
errors.schedule_client_mismatch: Selected rate card belongs to a different client and cannot be attached to this price plan.
errors.schedule_required_for_client_scope: This package is scoped to a client. Pick or create a rate card for that client before adding a price plan.

validation.milestone_cyclic_block: Milestone billing is not supported on cyclic packages (RECURRING / CONTRACT × PER_CYCLE / multi-visit).
validation.ad_hoc_invalid_basis: On-call engagements require amount basis = Total Package (retainer) or Per service call.
validation.ad_hoc_billing_incompatible_with_cycle_c: On-call engagements cannot have a billing cycle.
validation.ad_hoc_visits_per_cycle_must_be_one: On-call engagements cannot use multi-visit cycles.
validation.ad_hoc_pool_no_template: On-call retainer engagements require the Package to have an Engagement Template.
validation.ad_hoc_per_call_no_template: Per-call engagements require the Package to have an Engagement Template.
validation.ad_hoc_entitlement_required: On-call retainer engagements require entitled service calls > 0.
validation.ad_hoc_entitlement_invalid_for_per_call: Entitled service calls are only valid on retainer engagements, not per-call.
